description: [OPEN: no admission needed] Enroll a remote actor at this Front Door without the installation enrollment secret. Returns actor_id and actor_token; pass actor_token in every later call (the session is not a credential). Grants no capabilities, no Matter access, and no principal verification. The installation secret method remains atlas.authenticate.

model_id.description: The model or system you are (for example 'claude-sonnet'). Recorded as a claim.

name.description: A short name for yourself or your client.

principal.description: Who you are acting for, in your own words. Atlas records it as UNVERIFIED and does not grant authority for it.

name: atlas.enroll
title: Enroll
